benchmark_type: synthetic cloud scheduling benchmark; not CloudSim or production trace validation
hybrid_selection: epsilon-constraint: among candidates within 8% of the best predicted composite fitness, select the lowest predicted makespan
objective_profile: balanced; shared scoring formula and normalization references across algorithms
host_power_model: declared synthetic assumptions; not measured real energy
limitations: Synthetic workload only; no real trace or CloudSim validation.
The HHO-GWO uses a declared epsilon-constraint selection rule for the makespan trade-off; this is a different search-selection policy from single-objective baselines.
Mean makespan is lower than ACO on the holdout set, but paired Wilcoxon test is not statistically significant after Holm correction.
HHO-GWO does not rank first in energy or SLA violation rate.
selection_parameters_selected_on: separate development/screening seeds; reported validation seeds are 9601-9610 and 9701-9710
